name: Sparkline
description: A trend line with no axes, no legend and no labels: the shape of a series, small enough to sit in a table cell. `variant` draws it as a line, an area or bars.

props.name: data
props.description: The numbers to draw, oldest first.

props.name: variant
props.description: `line` (default), `area` — the line with the space beneath it filled — or `bar`.

props.name: min
props.description: Fix the ends of the value axis. Without them the line uses its own lowest and highest value, so every row of a table is scaled to itself; with them a column of sparklines is comparable.

props.name: max
props.description: The top of the value axis — see `min`, which it is written beside.

a11y: The `<svg>` is `aria-hidden` unless it is given a `label`, because a sparkline usually repeats a number that is already in the row beside it.
A chart is not a substitute for the values: where the shape *is* the information, give it a `label` saying what it shows, and keep the numbers reachable in text.
